resources.string: Shizuku restart
Restart with Shizuku
Saves your current configuration, force stops Bilibili and opens it again, then checks the new process and current configuration receipt. You can cancel or use the manual restart guide.
Shizuku is not installed.
Start the Shizuku service in its manager, then return here.
Shizuku API 13 or later is required.
Shizuku authorization is required. Authorization alone will not restart Bilibili.
Authorization was denied or revoked. Allow this module in Shizuku, then return here.
Shizuku is authorized. Tap below to save and restart Bilibili.
Shizuku disconnected or authorization was revoked. Check the service and retry.
Waiting for Shizuku authorization…
Saving the current configuration…
Connecting to the restart service…
Force stopping Bilibili and checking that its processes exit…
Opening Bilibili and checking its new process…
Bilibili started. Checking its current configuration receipt…
Could not save the current configuration. Bilibili was not restarted.
Could not confirm that Bilibili stopped. It has not been opened again.
Bilibili stopped, but its new process could not be confirmed. Open it manually.
The new process started, but its current configuration receipt is unconfirmed. Check Diagnostics.
Configuration or authorization changed. This restart attempt was cancelled; retry with the current configuration.
Restart cancelled. If Bilibili has already stopped, open it manually.
New Bilibili process and current configuration receipt confirmed.
New Bilibili process confirmed that the current module configuration is disabled.
Another restart is in progress.
